capabilities: Highlight or underline selected PDF text in configurable colors
Place draggable annotation cards or popovers in the page margin
Store each PDF's annotations as a managed Markdown note in the vault
Edit, recolor, and delete annotations from the card footer
Search all annotations in an index view and jump to the exact selection
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); depends on the built-in PDF reader's internal DOM, so major Obsidian updates may require adaptation; scanned/image-only PDFs without a text layer cannot be annotated precisely.
intentEvidence: Page-margin annotations over Obsidian's built-in PDF reader.
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF reader offers no way to annotate pages; highlights and notes don't persist alongside the PDF in the vault.
summary: A margin-annotation layer for Obsidian's built-in PDF reader: highlight or underline text and attach draggable note cards in the page margin.
